_about: Curated allowlist/denylist for the spaceId -> partitionId core re-point (epic memql#2031, issue #2033 / B1). Reuses the si_to_ai.py engine via --rules.
_modes: token = full identifier boundary both sides; infix = appears anywhere inside an identifier (for the camelCase suffix forms like voiceAgentSpaceId / GetSpaceId / activeSpaceId). The denylist + overlap-refusal protect namespace/workspace compounds that happen to contain the substring 'spaceId'.
_scope: CORE memql repo only. Do NOT run against the product pack or frontend repos with the same rules blindly -- those runs are coordinated separately in B1's wire-sweep siblings.
_caveat: This is an IDENTIFIER rename. Where a core row models product room-membership (participant.spaceId, utterance.spaceId, audioOverride...), the field NAME becomes partitionId while the VALUE is still a v1:cognition:space id until the scoping value is re-pointed / the concept moves to the pack (B2). Flagged for owner review on the PR.
